workflows.name: planning
workflows.fallback: Use ordinary conversation for the one approval and persist the plan under .mentor; follow skills/planning/SKILL.md → After Proceed for the run, host fallbacks, grading and tick order. Resolve roles by described purpose after explicit session mappings, and open each brief with the plan-level Goal:. A new tick reads the latest saved verdicts/step-N.md PASS once after the PASS row and record-write; a saved Grading: self-graded PASS can tick when subagents are unavailable. Released legacy verdict paths, optional headers, historical ticks and both released playbook aliases remain readable. Deterministic output reuse requires the verifier contract’s proven-identical clean tree and unchanged inputs; every stage gets a fresh grade, while live CI, external state and timing-sensitive repeats run again. Principles load at named decision points; selected playbooks’ bounded optional Run rules govern the run; rationale is editing-only. Plan-file tracking on every host: create the plan at research start, log rejection feedback, call plan-state.sh record-write <slug> after mentor writes, and inspect drift <slug> (known/changed/unknown). Claude-only hooks: per-prompt plan pointer (context-gate.sh), SessionStart re-attachment (plan-reattach.sh), and automatic hook-recorded plan_sha256 hashes on Write/Edit (plan-open.sh). Codex has no automatic prompt pointer, SessionStart block or write hook; use the durable plan and the portable record-write, drift and tick commands explicitly. Playbooks: Planning reads software-change, retrospective, investigation, hillclimb and prototype as indexed references through skills/planning/references/playbooks.md, selected by requested plan deliverable with seven public skills. Investigation is read-only and writes only its .mentor evidence and deliverable; hillclimb requires the target AND minimum N attempts within recorded caps, with software-change as sole delivery owner when combined; prototype delivers variants and observed comparison evidence for the human to pick, never ships prototype code, and never loads mid-plan or for bare mockup requests. The references need no hooks or command facades; use available research, measurement and observation tools, reporting any required evidence that cannot be obtained. Retrospective: The retro runs on Claude Code or Codex and reads source transcripts from either host's store (resolving identity from $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID or $CODEX_THREAD_ID, else a unique cwd + opening-prompt match). Planning reads the retrospective reference through skills/planning/references/playbooks.md, so it needs no slash-command facade; /mentor:retro is a thin Claude Code entry point. When subagents are unavailable the three lenses run serially in-thread and are labelled self-graded. When session identity or a transcript store cannot be resolved, the result is labelled partial with no fallback to the real stores.

workflows.name: ux-review
workflows.fallback: Use the portable skill directly from ordinary conversation; it needs no Mentor helper or .mentor state.

workflows.name: delivery
workflows.fallback: Planning reads the software-change reference through skills/planning/references/playbooks.md. Without slash-command facades use the host's shell and approval flow; without subagents the pre-merge grade is self-graded and says so.
